skill_name: Design a furniture piece that is both attractive and functional
workflow: This multifunctional furniture piece features clean lines and a modern aesthetic. It features four shelves, two on either side of the frame, creating ample storage without taking up too much space. It has a sturdy frame crafted from solid wood and reinforced with metal brackets for strength. The shelving is made from lightweight and durable bamboo, with rounded edges for safety.
